components.name: Signal Button
components.description: The primary compile or open action.
components.css: .ds-signal { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid #FF645F; border-radius: 10px; background: #FF645F; color: #080404; font: 600 14px/1 IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-signal:hover { background: #FFA8A0; } .ds-signal:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FF645F; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Source Preset
components.description: A real owned-fixture selector with a visible pressed state.
components.css: .ds-source { display: grid; min-height: 92px; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #432827; border-radius: 10px; background: #180D0D; color: #F9F4F3; text-align: left; } .ds-source[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #FF645F; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 #FF645F; } .ds-source small { color: #A69490; font: 12px/1.4 IBM Plex Mono, monospace; }

components.name: Compiler Rail
components.description: A sequential lifecycle readout for Snapshot, Derive and Register.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 1px; margin: 0; padding: 1px; border-radius: 10px; background: #432827; list-style: none; overflow: hidden; } .ds-rail li { min-height: 64px; padding: 14px; background: #180D0D; color: #A69490; font: 12px/1.4 IBM Plex Mono, monospace; } .ds-rail li[data-state="active"] { color: #FF645F; }

components.name: Tool Candidate
components.description: A candidate row with contract identity, review state and confidence evidence.
components.css: .ds-tool { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 64px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #432827; border-radius: 10px; background: #180D0D; color: #F9F4F3; text-align: left; } .ds-tool[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #FF645F; background: #281717; } .ds-tool code, .ds-tool b { font: 600 12px/1.3 IBM Plex Mono, monospace; }

components.name: Machine Field
components.description: A labelled schema field with visible help and focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Query<input aria-describedby="query-help"></label><small id="query-help">Words to match in the owned snapshot.</small>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #F9F4F3; font: 500 13px/1.4 IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #432827; border-radius: 10px; background: #180D0D; color: #F9F4F3; font: 13px/1.4 IBM Plex Mono, monospace; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FF645F; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Graft feels like serious infrastructure made unusually easy to inspect. The landing layer is calm, dark and editorial. The compiler is dense, operational and real. A restrained red signal marks the controlled join between an owned page and its typed agent interface.
keyCharacteristics: A premium near-black canvas with one red signal family
Editorial narrative paired with a real operating compiler
IBM Plex Sans for explanation and IBM Plex Mono for machine state
Visible permission, sanitization, review and registration boundaries
Responsive evidence that remains legible from 360px to 1440px

rules.name: One Live Signal
rules.body: Signal red identifies the primary action or current selection. It is not a general decoration color.

rules.name: Promise Then Proof
rules.body: Marketing copy introduces the claim, then the real compiler immediately demonstrates it.

rules.name: Human Versus Machine
rules.body: Human explanation stays in sentence-case IBM Plex Sans. Tool contracts and changing data use IBM Plex Mono.

rules.name: Evidence Over Ornament
rules.body: Generated imagery may establish the brand metaphor, but it never replaces the functional workbench or exact output.

dos: Do keep the real compiler visible as the product proof.
Do use semantic color tokens and state labels together.
Do preserve owned-source, review and native-registration boundaries.
Do inspect focus, overflow and expanded output at the supported widths.
donts: Don't turn the product into a fake dashboard screenshot.
Don't add extra accent colors or stack decorative gradients.
Don't use uppercase mono for all human-facing copy.
Don't hide meaningful state behind icon-only controls.
